channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Cloudflare Reclaims 100 TB of RAM by Optimizing Consistent Hashing
item.description: Cloudflare recently documented how it reduced the memory footprint of its internal load-balancing service by more than 100 TB by optimizing the Rust implementation of consistent hashing in pingora-ketama. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AWS Transit Gateway and AWS Cloud WAN now support 1:1 NAT
item.description: AWS Transit Gateway and AWS Cloud WAN now provide managed one-to-one network address translation (NAT) directly on their attachments, through integration with Regional Private NAT Gateway. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer Global Resiliency now supports persistent chat across linked AWS Regions
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer Global Resiliency now provides customers a mechanism to deliver long, persistent chat experiences across linked AWS Regions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon MWAA now available in Mexico (Central) Region
item.description: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) Provisioned environments are now available in the Mexico (Central) Region (mx-central-1). (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Introduces Lambda Web Functions for Node.js Applications
item.description: AWS recently introduced Lambda Web Functions, allowing developers to run Node.js web applications using frameworks such as Express and Hono directly on Lambda, with support for concurrent requests and response streaming. By Renato Losio (1 source: infoq)

item.title: CSIRO Uses Serverless Architecture to Query 100x More Genomic Variants on AWS
item.description: CSIRO has developed Serverless Beacon, a serverless architecture for querying genomic variants without copying VCF files into a central database. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon EMR on EKS reduces EMR charge by 30 percent
item.description: Amazon EMR announces a reduction of 30 percent in the EMR charge added to EKS when running EMR on EKS. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Web Search on AWS Bedrock now supports domain filtering and user location controls
item.description: Web Search on AWS Bedrock now supports two new controls that give you more precision over the results that ground a model's response: domain filtering and user location. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Corretto October 2026 Quarterly Updates
item.description: On October 22, 2026 Amazon announced quarterly security and critical updates for Amazon Corretto Long-Term Supported (LTS) versions of OpenJDK. (1 source: aws)
